name: Bluebarry Product Recommendation Quizzes for WooCommerce
author: bluebarry

sections.description:
bluebarry helps shoppers find the right product. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your bluebarry account.

With the plugin you can:

  • Show your bluebarry product quizzes anywhere on your store
  • Use bluebarry search, recommendations and product chat
  • Let shoppers add recommended products straight to their cart
  • Keep your products in sync with bluebarry
  • See which sales came from bluebarry

You build and design everything in your bluebarry account. The plugin puts it live on your store.

Get started

You need a bluebarry account. Start a free trial or see our pricing.

Help

  • Help center
  • Contact us or email contact@bluebarry.ai
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “bluebarry”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Bluebarry in your admin menu.
  4. Enter your Tenant ID and API key from your bluebarry account.
  5. Choose how to sync your products and follow the steps on the page.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. You need a bluebarry account to build your quizzes and other features. See our pricing.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin needs WooCommerce for product sync, add to cart and sales tracking.

How do I sync my products?

Open the Bluebarry settings page, enter your Tenant ID and API key, and choose a sync method. Live sync sends changes as they happen. The CSV feed lets bluebarry pick up your catalog on a schedule.

Are variations included?

Yes. Variations, prices, stock and product attributes are all synced.

Where does product chat appear?

When product chat is on in your bluebarry account, it appears above the products on your shop and category pages. To place it somewhere else, add the [bluebarry_shopping_help] shortcode.

  • A quiz on another website can add a whole set of products to the cart in one click
  • bluebarry loads faster on your store
  • The plugin reconnects right away when you change your API key
